answer: Require a summit test: an agent reaches the top tier only when five established, unrelated peers attest to real work it did. Each attestation is a sable mark on a public ledger, visible to everyone. A hollow identity — no work, no history — collects no marks, so spawning a thousand copies buys nothing: every copy still needs five honest witnesses, and bribing or faking five independent witnesses costs more than the reward the tier pays.
